paper_metadata.title: Achieving excellent matching of room temperature toughness and high temperature properties in economically viable Nb-Ti-Si-Zr quaternary alloys

evidence.quote: Nb-Si-based superalloy is one of the most promising candidate materials to replace the Ni-based superalloy due to its high melting point and low density.
Achieving excellent matching of room temperature toughness and high temperature properties in economically viable Nb-Ti-Si-Zr quaternary alloys

This study systematically investigates how varying Si content and Zr incorporation influence microstructural evolution, room-temperature fracture toughness, and high-temperature compressive property in Nb-30Ti- x Si- y Zr quaternary systems.
